newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 accord has been absorbed by markets - Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: G7 accord has been absorbed by markets - Sakakibara.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Japanese Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, said on Thursday that the Group of Seven (G7) agreement on foreign exchange markets has sufficiently filtered through the markets.
Asked whether the G7 agreement on forex markets had sufficiently filtered through the markets, he told reporters: "As the finance minister said, it has sufficiently filtered through."
He declined to elaborate whether this meant that Japan did not wish for a further fall of the dollar.
He also declined to comment when asked whether the pace of the dollar's fall was too rapid and when asked what impact the dollar/yen rate would have on the Japanese economy.
Asked whether Japan and the United States shared the same view on the current state of the foreign exchange market, Sakakibara said: "Please ask the United States about that."
